{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Read the sales data
sales_df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Replace invalid ages (negative values) with NaN
sales_df_clean = sales_df.copy()
sales_df_clean['customer_age'] = pd.to_numeric(sales_df_clean['customer_age'], errors='coerce')

# Filter out negative ages
valid_age_rows = sales_df_clean[sales_df_clean['customer_age'] >= 0]

# Compute the mean age of valid customers
mean_age = valid_age_rows['customer_age'].mean()

# Also compute the count of valid customers
valid_count = len(valid_age_rows)

mean_age, valid_count"}
